release_rule: Fail closed. Download only assets with an explicit allowlisted redistribution licence and complete attribution; retain per-file provenance.

sources.licence: Per-file; restricted by this harvester to CC0 / CC BY / CC BY-SA
sources.conditions: Creator, landing URL, licence name, and licence URL are mandatory. Public-domain tags other than explicit CC0 are excluded.

sources.licence: Discovery filter: CC0 or CC BY metadata only; authority remains the foreign source landing page
sources.conditions: Every row records foreign_landing_url and the returned licence fields with verification_status=unverified. Exclude from release until the licence is verified on that landing page.

sources.licence: Images listed as CC BY 2.0; annotations CC BY 4.0
sources.conditions: Accept only metadata rows with CC BY 2.0, author, and original landing page. Record verification_status=unverified and exclude from release until that page is checked.
Retain dataset attribution and citation on every derived image row.
ETH states that images belong to Foodspotting contributors and use beyond scientific fair use must be negotiated with each owner. No adapter downloads these files.

sources.licence: HF card says CC BY 4.0; source images are Yelp Open Dataset
sources.conditions: The HF card does not document authority to relicense Yelp-origin photos under CC BY 4.0. Excluded pending written clarification or per-image rights.
